messages:
Asha (People Ops): Putting a compact manager + HR checklist here for Riley starting Monday. Keep replies short so ops can action overnight.

Preboarding (today):
- Confirm legal full name + preferred display name.
- Ensure ID docs uploaded to HR portal.
- Device & badge queued: Jordan -> confirm courier vs front-desk pickup.
- Invite Riley to #product, #eng-all, #new-hires.
- Create onboarding checklist in OnboardBot and share link.

Day 1 (morning):
- 10:00: Welcome + security brief (Jordan).
- 11:00: Team meet-and-greet (20m). No slides, just intros.
- 13:00: PM onboarding + product tour (Lina).
- 15:00: 1:1 with manager (Matt) to set priorities & expectations.
- Assign first micro-deliverable: review last sprint's postmortem and list 3 quick wins.

Week 1 outcomes:
- Complete SSO + MFA setup.
- Finish required trainings: security, privacy, and product basics.
- Ship first short doc summarizing initial observations.
- Identify stakeholders for 30/60/90 planning.

Suggested 30/60/90 bullet points (paste into 1:1):
- 30d: Understand users and metrics, complete onboarding tasks, own one small feature spec.
- 60d: Lead cadence for a small cross-functional project and iterate based on feedback.
- 90d: Deliver measurable improvement (eg. reduce time-to-first-success by X%).

Logistics & quick links:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/onboard (Asha)
- Badge pickup: main lobby or courier (Jordan)
- Console access request: /forms/console-access (Matt add GitHub handle)

Matt (Eng Manager): I'll send the welcome note and set a daily 15min sync for week 1. Buddy: Lina confirmed. Asha can you add Lina to the OnboardBot checklist as mentor?

Asha (People Ops): Done. Added Lina as mentor and set reminders for day 3 and day 7 check-ins. OnboardBot created checklist ID OB-1712349999: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-1712349999

Jordan (IT): Laptop (14" MBP) imaged and badge printed. Pickup at security 09:30 or I can overnight courier. Riley, DM if you want the courier option. Also we need your phone for MFA or we can issue a YubiKey.

Lina (Product Buddy): Happy to run product walkthrough. Suggest we show backlog, metrics dashboard, and an example customer ticket during the tour.

Matt (Eng Manager): Quick ask: please block 30m on day 2 for "first task handoff" so we can go over the small spec.

Asha (People Ops): Noted. Day 2 14:00 blocked. Also Riley, please complete the tax & benefits forms within 5 business days to avoid delays.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: security training due in 72 hours; HR forms due in 5 days.

Matt (Eng Manager): One more thing 12: add Riley to the oncall rotation docs read-only access. Alex (platform) can help with permissions.

Asha (People Ops): Adding that to checklist.

Jordan (IT): FYI we also need the GitHub username for team mapping. Matt, ping me the handle and I'll sync groups.

Matt (Eng Manager): Will DM it now.

Riley (incoming PM): Thanks team! Appreciate the clear steps. One Q: is there a preferred format for the 1-page notes doc?

Lina (Product Buddy): Nothing formal. Bulleted notes + 3 prioritized findings works well. Share in #product and attach to the OnboardBot checklist.

Asha (People Ops): Great. Closing preboarding items unless anyone raises blockers tonight. Reply here if something changes. :thumbsup:
